brief:
Malaysia has recognized Palestinian halal certification, the Ma'an news agency reported. The move opens new opportunities for Palestinian national exports to Malaysian markets and other countries that accept Malaysian halal standards.

The recognition is expected to facilitate Palestinian agricultural and food product exports, as halal certification from recognized bodies is required for market access in Malaysia and other Muslim-majority nations. Malaysian halal standards are widely accepted internationally, potentially broadening the reach of Palestinian goods beyond regional markets.
title: Malaysia recognizes Palestinian halal certificates, opening export markets
